sprint_weekends_2024_audit.notes: Standard Red Bull dominance; won sprint and main race from pole.
McLaren introduced massive floor upgrade. Norris benefited from fortunate safety car timing and superior race pace.
Verstappen led 63 laps; slow pit stop allowed Norris to attack; lap 64 collision eliminated both from the lead, handing win to Russell.
Norris and Verstappen fought into Turn 1, opening the inside line for Leclerc to take lead from P4; Ferrari displayed dominant race stint pace.
Torrential rain and red flag timing. Verstappen executed historic charge from P17 in wet conditions.
Verstappen qualified P1 but received 1-place penalty for slow in-lap; started P2. Model B picked Russell from P1. Verstappen overtook into Turn 1.

red_bull.notes: High rolling form maintained strong predictive confidence.

mclaren.notes: Predicted McLaren correctly once rolling form caught up at Zandvoort, Hungary, and Singapore.

ferrari.notes: Only hit Monaco (P1). Ferrari victories featured tactical 1-stop strategy (Monza) or front-row battles (Austin).

mercedes.notes: Mercedes won opportunistically via collision (Austria) and mixed conditions (Silverstone, Spa).

available_historical_sources.ergast_f1_api: Historical results, qualifying times, pit stops, lap times available 1950-2024.
available_historical_sources.fastf1_telemetry: Telemetry, session weather, compound stints, sector times available 2018-2024.
available_historical_sources.openf1_api: Real-time radio, car data, intervals available 2023-2024.
available_historical_sources.fia_timing_documents: Official classification, starting grids, penalty notices available 2000-2024.

potential_session_level_features.description: Median lap time on high-fuel race simulation stints in Practice 2.
potential_session_level_features.leakage_risk: None. FP2 occurs Friday afternoon, strictly prior to Qualifying and Starting Grid.
potential_session_level_features.missing_data_protocol: On Sprint weekends, FP2 does not exist. Must impute or use Sprint Race pace.

potential_session_level_features.description: Driver best Q3 (or best reached session) lap time as a percentage difference to pole time.
potential_session_level_features.leakage_risk: None. Qualifying concludes Saturday afternoon, strictly prior to Starting Grid.
potential_session_level_features.missing_data_protocol: Drivers without representative time (crashed in Q1) assigned maximum delta (e.g. +5.0%).

potential_session_level_features.description: Finishing position in Saturday 100km sprint race.
potential_session_level_features.leakage_risk: None on Sprint weekends. Occurs Saturday morning before main Qualifying.

potential_session_level_features.description: Historical overtaking frequency (Monaco=0.05, Spa=0.85) to scale penalty decay.
potential_session_level_features.leakage_risk: None. Static track property known prior to weekend.

feature_data_availability_assessment.conclusion: Historical session-level features (Qualifying lap delta, FP2 long-run pace, track overtaking index) can be constructed with zero data leakage for 2021-2024. However, sprint weekends lack FP2, requiring a branched feature pipeline that leverages Saturday Sprint Race pace instead of practice simulation.
